sentences.en: "Define your terms," requested the businessman at the contract hearings.
sentences.zh: 在合同听证会上，那位商人要求‘明确条款’。

sentences.en: In mathematics, a straight line is defined by two points.
sentences.zh: 在数学中，一条直线由两个点来定义。

sentences.en: What defines us is how well we arise after falling.
sentences.zh: 决定我们的是我们在跌倒后站起来的能力。
